summary: Baileys WhatsApp library fork — static keyword co-occurrence in utility module
details: Package is a fork of the Baileys WhatsApp Web API library. A pattern rule flagged lib/Utils/generics.js on keyword co-occurrence ("ping", "GET", "id") within a utility module of a WhatsApp client library, where such tokens routinely appear as WebSocket keepalive/ping handling and HTTP GET helpers native to the library's documented purpose. No traced code path shows reading of installer-side secrets (env vars, ~/.aws, ~/.ssh, ~/.npmrc, browser stores), no hardcoded attacker C2, no install-time lifecycle hook fetching or executing remote content, no dropper, no backdoor, and no silent-relay of caller-supplied data to a non-first-party destination. The flagged tokens are consistent with the library's normal WhatsApp protocol handling rather than an exfiltration path.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
